metadata.title: On cylindrical directions of regular surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ derived from contact with spherical cylinders
metadata.abstract: We investigate the contact of regular surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ with spherical cylinders $S^2(r) \times \mathbb{R}$. We introduce cylindrical directions of these surfaces, defined by the axes of spherical cylinders having degenerate contact with the surfaces, and show that these directions capture the ridge condition of projected regular surfaces under orthogonal projection along these directions.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究R⁴中正则曲面与球柱面S²(r)×R的接触，以与曲面退化接触的球柱轴定义柱方向，并证明沿这些方向作正交投影后的正则曲面，其脊线条件由这些方向捕捉。
analysis.breakthrough: 以高维外蕴接触数据解释投影后的曲率脊线几何。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列退化阶数和投影正则性细节，不能写为所有投影方向的完整奇点分类，也不是内蕴曲率比较。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 微分几何中的局部曲面形状分析，中等偏低优先。
